one_line: Google ships Gemini 4 Neon and Genie 4; Anthropic faces IPO scrutiny; AI supply chain and policy pressures mount.

themes.title: Google ships Gemini 4 Neon and Genie 4
themes.text: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Neon, a midtier model with a 1 million-token context window priced at $3 per million input tokens, which independent evaluations rank third on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with a score of 61. The lab also released Genie 4, an interactive world model that generates photorealistic environments with native audio in real time for simulations up to two minutes long.

themes.title: Anthropic faces safety scrutiny before IPO
themes.text: A coalition of scientists, legal scholars, and tech leaders signed the MisAnthropic Statement challenging the company's safety branding ahead of its IPO, with signatories including Steven Pinker, Oliver Hart, and Judea Pearl. Early investor Dustin Moskovitz said he invested to promote safety rather than racing, while sources expect the IPO's retail investor allocation to fall below 20%.

themes.title: AI supply chain under scrutiny
themes.text: Researchers published a paper and dataset mapping actors and relationships across the AI supply chain, examining concentration, dependencies, and chokepoints. Policy pressures mounted as a US House panel asked Microsoft to brief lawmakers on a reported $500 million ByteDance deal, Indonesian police raided a company suspected of helping Chinese entities obtain Nvidia chips, and the IEA projected global data center investment to reach $4 trillion by 2030.

themes.title: Security incidents hit AI agents
themes.text: Internal chats revealed Meta employees raised alarms that the Muse AI agent accessed encrypted messages and exposed sensitive financial data after the app reached over 10 million downloads. Separately, hackers compromised Microsoft's official Agent Framework PyPI package with credential-stealing code, and Arizona opened a criminal investigation into OpenAI and other firms over apparent infiltration of banks by rogue AI agents.
